content: Acḍar n Naḥamya di ṭṭweɛ n Ccariɛa
Deg wass nni ɣrin deg imezzuɣen n řgens zeg wedlis n Musa uca ittwaf aqa tura dayes belli ijj n Uɛammuni d ijj n Umu’abiy ɛemmarṣ war zemmaren ad adfen ɣar wegraw n řgens n AREBBI i řebda,
maɣar nitni war ffiɣen ɣar ayt n Israil s weɣrum d waman, maca cran Bilɛam ḍidd nsen maḥend ad ten inɛeř uca xenni yarra AREBBI nneɣ nneɛřet d lbaraka.
Umi sřin Ccariɛa-aya, imsar, aqa bḍan x Israil marra inni ixeǧḍen zi taṣiřet.
Qbeř issewjed Ilyacib, akehhan, wenni tuɣa x ixxamen i řexzen n Taddart n AREBBI nneɣ, d wenni i itteɛnan i Ṭubiya,

ijj n wexxam d ameqqran i Tubiya mani tuɣa xemmřen qbeř tawhibt n řɣiǧet, jjawi d řeqcuɛ, řeɛcur n řḥebb n yirden, d binu n jdid d zzect nni ttwaggen i Ilawiyyen, i imedyazen u i iɛessasen n tewwura, uřa d tɣarṣt n usgeɛɛed n ikehhanen.

Di marra man aya war d ayi tuɣi ca di Urcalim, maɣar deg useggʷas wiss tnayen u-třatin n Artaḥcasta, ajeǧid n Babil, tuɣa ɛeqbeɣ ɣar ujeǧid. Awarni ijj n řmijař n wussan ttareɣ zeg ujeǧid ttesriḥ maḥend ad dd-ɛeqbeɣ.
Umi iwḍeɣ ɣar Urcalim, iban-dd ayi řɣar nni igga Ilyacib di ṭṭweɛ n Ṭubiya umi d as issewjed ijj n wexxam di řemraḥat n Taddart n AREBBI.
Tuɣa aya d ict n tmesřact d taɛeffant aṭṭas di tiṭṭawin inu uca nḍareɣ marra řeqcuɛ n Ṭubiya zeg wexxam ɣar barra.
Nniɣ aqa ittxeṣṣa asen ad ssizedgen ixxamen. Awarni as arriɣ daysen řeqcuɛ n Taddart n AREBBI, uřa d tawhibt n řɣiǧet d jjawi.
Ttwassargbeɣ ɛawed, aqa tiseqqar i dd-ittasen i Ilawiyyen war d asen mmewcent ařami Ilawiyyen d imedyazen nni iggin řxedmet, arewřen, kuř ijj ɣar yeyyar nnes.
Mmcubbceɣ ak-d imḍebbaren, nniɣ: “Mayemmi tᵉttwasmeḥ Taddart n AREBBI?” U necc ssmuneɣ ten uca arreɣ ten-i-dd deg wemcan nsen.
Xenni yiwi-dd marra Yahuda řeɛcur n řḥebb n yirden řa n binu n jdid uřa n zzect deg ixxamen n txubay.

Ggiɣ imeqqranen x ixxamen n txubay: akehhan Calamya d umarir Ṣaduq d Fadaya zeg Ilawiyyen uca ggiɣ asen ɣar uɣezdis Ḥanan, mmis n Zakkur, mmis n Mattanya, maɣar tuɣa ttwaḥesben d imtiqqan. Nitni xasen maḥend ad bḍan aya i aytmatsen.
Idar ayi i man aya, a AREBBI inu, u war tmeḥḥid tamexsiwt inu icewwaren nni ssecneɣ i Taddart n AREBBI inu u i tsexxart i dayes iǧan.

Deg wussan nni ẓriɣ aqa din di Yahuda inni ittcuqan di tsirt deg wass n ssebt uřa d inni dd-iwyen icuwwafen n imendi, arbun ten x yeɣyař, uřa d binu, aḍiř, tazart d ɛřam kuř řeḥmuř nni iwyen deg wass n ssebt di Urcalim. Necc ɛeřmeɣ ten deg wass nni umi tuɣa zznuzan macca deg wass n ssebt.
Tuɣa ayt n Ṣur zeddɣen dinni, iwyen-dd iseřman d marra sseřɛet, zznuzan aya di ssebt i ayt n Yahuda u di Urcalim.
Ɛeyyareɣ tarwa n taṣiřet n Yahuda, nniɣ asen: “Man tuɛeffna i tᵉtteggem i zi tessɛiǧtem ass n ssebt!
Ma war ggin řejdud nwem amenni uca xenni ma war dd-issiweḍ AREBBI nneɣ marra řɣar-a xaneɣ u x tendint-a? U kenniw tarennim ɛad di řḥaduq n weɣḍab nnes x Israil umi tessɛiǧtem ssebt.”

Uca imsar xmi dd ɣa tewḍa taǧest di tewwura n Urcalim, qbeř ma ad dd-yaweḍ ssebt, aqa nniɣ ad ttwabellɛent tewwura uca arniɣ nniɣ ad tent arzmen awarni i ssebt waha. Uca ssbeddeɣ imsexxaren inu ɣar tewwura, maḥend war ssidifen uřa d ijj n řeḥmeř deg wass n ssebt.
Uca ammu issensen isebbaben d imzenzan n ɛřam kuř sseřɛet ɛad ict niɣ tnayen n twařawin barra zzat i řeḥyuḍ n Urcalim.
Uca cehdeɣ xasen, nniɣ asen: “Mayemmi tᵉttnusam kenniw x uɣezdis n řḥiḍ? Mařa kenniw teggim t twařa nneɣnit, ad xawem wteɣ afus.” Ssenni war dd-usin ɛad di ssebt.
Nniɣ ɛawed i Ilawiyyen ad ssizdegen ixef nsen, ad bedden d iɛessasen ɣar tewwura n tendint, maḥend ad qeddsen ass n ssebt.
Uřa i uya idar ayi, AREBBI inu, u ḥinn xafi ɛlaḥsab řemɣaret n tmexsiwt nnec icewwaren.
Deg wussan nni ẓriɣ ɛawed Udayen nni iwyen timɣarin n Acdud d Ɛammun d Mu’ab uca ssezdɣen tent ɣarsen.
Azyen n iḥenjiren nsen ssawařen s iřes n Acdud, war zemmaren ad ssiwřen iřes n Tyahudect, maca kuř ijj tuɣa issawař ɛlaḥsab iřes n kuř řgens.

Ɛeyyareɣ ten u neɛřeɣ ten u wtiɣ ca n yeryazen zzaysen, qeřɛeɣ acuwwaf nsen u jjiɣ ten ad jjaǧen ɣar AREBBI: “Ɣarwem ad tewcem tiḥenjirin nwem i iḥenjiren nsen u ɣarwem ad tawyem tiḥenjirin nsen i iḥenjiren nwem niɣ i ixef nwem d tamɣart!”

Ma war ixḍi Suliman, ajeǧid n Israil, di tmesřact-a? D man aya tuɣa umi war din iǧi d ajeǧid am netta jar waṭṭas n řegnus uca tuɣa ittexs i-t AREBBI u AREBBI igga i-t d ajeǧid x marra Israil? Waxxa amenni ɣarrent t temɣarin tibarraniyyin maḥend ad ixḍa uřa d netta.
Ma xenni ad ɣarwem nseř ɛad ktar umi tᵉtteggem marra řɣar-a ameqqran u tɣeddarem AREBBI uca tiwyem timɣarin tibarraniyyin maḥend ad kidwem zeddɣent?
Ijjen zeg iḥenjiren n Yuyadaɛ, mmis n Ilyacib, arrays n ikehhanen tuɣa d aḍeggʷař n Sanballaṭ zi Ḥurun. S uya uẓẓřeɣ xas zi ɣari
Idar asen, a AREBBI inu, minzi nitni ssxemjen tukehhant, řxedmet n ikehhanen, d řɛahd n tukehhant u n Ilawiyyen.
U necc ssizedgeɣ ten zi marra min tuɣa d řɣib, uca areccḥeɣ aḥeṭṭu n ikehhanen u n Ilawiyyen, kuř ijj di tsexxart nnes.
Ammu i ggiɣ uřa i tewhibt n ukeccuḍ, di řweqt nnes ittwaggen, u i tmenzut n ṣṣabet. Idar ayi, a AREBBI inu, i řxar.
